Correct: only the first block lower flux feeds the actual reset law in block two; only the last block lower exit increments the nth-hit accumulator. Upper exits from either excursion absorb permanently; auxiliary q killing is accounted separately.

Correct: serial kernel uses active clock without d; candidate H2 and second-loss multiply eta exactly once in readout.
